evidence_chain.finding: Explicitly acknowledges ordinary YOLO loss does not mask ignored negative regions.
Publisher score=0/category 0 or 11 rows are excluded from YOLO positives; ignored rows also remain in sidecars. Preparation-quality exclusions are distinguished.
Only ordinary image/YOLO label copies are exposed in data.yaml; no ignore geometry is provided to criterion.
Unassigned anchor target scores are zero; zero BCE targets still incur background loss.
Assign from regular GT, calculate BCE for all anchors/classes, optionally apply class weights, sum every entry with original target-score denominator.
Box and DFL branches operate on fg_mask positives; the proposed primitive never changes them.
Ordinary transform/collation supports specific fields; arbitrary ignore sidecars are not automatically transformed, merged or indexed.

historical_pin_limit: loss.py and tal.py were not separately pinned in training_contract_v3. This review pins their current installed bytes only. Dataset/augment/tasks pins are checked; historical contract explicitly acknowledges the same gap, but no retrospective byte identity is claimed for unpinned files.

proposed_policy.inside: x1 <= anchor_x < x2 and y1 <= anchor_y < y2

ignore_source_policy_proposed_not_loaded.include: Nonempty clipped publisher_ignored regions (score=0 or category in {0,11}) for authorized train rows only.
ignore_source_policy_proposed_not_loaded.exclude: Do not silently convert preparation-quality invalid positive geometry into publisher-ignore regions; fail/quarantine through a separately reviewed policy.
ignore_source_policy_proposed_not_loaded.class_semantics: All such regions would suppress every class at unassigned anchors. This deliberately stronger class-agnostic policy is an engineering proposal, not official class-specific score=0 matching semantics.
ignore_source_policy_proposed_not_loaded.selection_holdout: Neither may enter training loss preparation or tuning.

augmentation_integration_required: Carry ignore geometry and source identities separately from positive Instances; never add ignored boxes to TAL GT.
Use the exact sampled resize/pad/crop/mosaic/flip parameters applied to the image, not an independently sampled second transform.
Mosaic must merge every contributing source ignore set, map placement/crop, and clip to final canvas; arbitrary dict fields are currently dropped by final_labels reconstruction.
Use a loss-specific clipped region validity rule, not positive box_candidates area/aspect filtering; dropping tiny ignore remnants silently reintroduces negative gradients.

Current frozen defaults have degrees/shear/perspective=0, mixup/cutmix/copy_paste=0. A first integration must assert these settings or implement separately reviewed polygon/paste semantics. AABB after rotation can ignore extra background.
Photometric transforms need no geometry change, but any spatial Albumentations must expose/replay geometry or be rejected.
Format and collate must preserve ragged per-image ignore boxes and explicit batch identity; criterion receives final-canvas pixel coordinates after multi-scale preprocessing, if enabled.
Unit tests of this primitive do not verify these unimplemented data-flow requirements.

unchanged_at_fixed_inputs: positive all-class BCE terms and gradients
retained negative BCE terms and gradients
normalization_and_noninterference.not_claimed: Shared-parameter gradients and future training trajectories necessarily can change after removing negative terms; no training efficacy or official semantics is established.
